Lockheed Martin develops mission software solutions for complex national security challenges. The Software Engineer will work on cross-functional Agile teams to implement secure, full-stack web and Java mission capabilities for USSTRATCOM’s Strategic Mission Planning and Execution System in a DevSecOps environment.

• Experience with Relational Database Access / SQL / JPA / Hibernate
• Engineering experience with AFNWC SMPES, MPAS, NPES Systems

Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be offered depending on the position. Payments under these annual programs are not guaranteed and can vary from year to year and are tied to a range of performance metrics.
For Washington state applicants only, non-represented full-time employees accrue at least 10 hours per month of Paid Time Off (PTO) to be used for incidental absences and other reasons and receive at least 90 hours for holidays.
For Washington state applicants only, represented full-time employees accrue 6.67 hours of Vacation per month, accrue up to 52 hours of sick leave annually, and receive at least 96 hours for holidays. PTO, Vacation, sick leave, and holiday hours are prorated based on start date during the calendar year.
